title.th: คำสั่งแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมคำสั่งสรรพสามิต พ.ศ. 2560

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Excise (Amendment) (No. 2 ) Order, 2017 · lnsertion of new section 13A into S 40 / 2006

Section 13 of the Excise Order, 2006 , in the Order referred to as the principal Order, is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after section 13 "Power of Minister to defer excise duties etc. 13A , ( 1 ) The Minister may, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, by regulations, in relation to dutiable goods imported by any person in the course or furtherance of any business carried on by him (a ) provide fo r the payment of excise duty to be deferred and subject to such requirements and conditions as may be imposed by the Controller ( b ) permit those goods to be removed from the place of manufacture specified in a licence under section 53 , Ports Department warehouse, exclse warehouse or licensed warehouse, as the case may be, in accordance with those regulations notwithstanding that the excise duty chargeable on the importation has yet to be paid. ( 2 ) Regulations made under subsection ( 1 ) ) may provide that such goods subject to such requirements and conditions as may be imposed by the ControIIer, (b ) require the person to account fo r and pay the excise duty chargeable on the importation of the goods in such form and manner, within such time and to such person as m ay be determined by the Controller. " 5124 25th. SEPTEMBER, 2017 Amendment of section 70

Section 70 of the principal Order is amended (a ) by inserting " ( 1 ) " immediately before "No " in the first line; ( b ) by inserting the following new subsection immediately after the provlso " ( 2 ) For the avoidance of doubt, subsection ( 1 ) does not apply to dutiable goods where the Controller has given permission for its removal in respect of which payment of excise duty is deferred in accordance with regulations made under section 13A · Amendment of section 161

Section 161 of the principal Order is amended by inserting ' or any regulations made thereunder " immediately after "Order " in the first line. Made this 29th. day of Zulhijjah, 1438 Hijriah corresponding to the 21st. day of September 2017 at Our lstana Nurul lman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM 5125
